eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CHILD ABDUCTION EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Cuyahoga; Ashtabula; Erie; Geauga; Huron; Lake; Lorain; Medina; Portage, OH; at 12:50 AM on AUG 18, 2021 Effective until 1:50 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
The City of Cleveland has issued an AMBER Alert for an abducted 6-week-old male Cannon Tatum. Cannon is a white male, 21 inches, 14 pounds, with black hair, and gray eyes.  Last seen wearing a tan onesie with a teddy bear print.   The child was reportedly taken by a family friend, TaShanee Dumas on August 17th at approximately 10 p. m.  Suspect described as a 23-year-old black female, 5 foot 2 inches, 210 pounds with brown hair, and brown eyes.  Suspect and child last seen in the area of West 85th and Madison in Cleveland. The suspect was driving a Black 2006 Chevy Impala, bearing Ohio license plate of M388569. 

Anyone having information on this abduction please call the Cleveland Police Department at 216-623-5200, or dial 9-1-1.
